title: Starving Anonymous
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High school students Ie and Kazu are gassed on the bus home from school and wake aboard a truck packed with human bodies, where living workers are sawing frozen corpses into pieces. They must work out where they are and how to escape a facility that treats people as a food supply.
life_message: Human life is not raw material; the will to survive and stay human resists any system that treats people as livestock.
